content.comment_body: Hello, I am trying to read the time data from a [product_name] module using Node-RED. While I can access I/O signals with the 'node-red-contrib-s7' package, I do not see any option for reading the module clock.

It is possible to retrieve both date and time information by reading individual bytes from their corresponding addresses. You can also write to these addresses. Please refer to the attached reference for details.
Thank you, this method worked perfectly! For others looking for a similar solution, here's an example: In Node-RED, the address DB1,BYTE988 represents hours.

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion focused on accessing real-time clock information from a [product_name] module via Node-RED. Initially, there was difficulty since no direct support was available in the S7 Node-RED connector. Success was eventually achieved by manually decoding the clock data through byte-by-byte address mapping.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hoped for a simple, integrated method to read the [product_name] clock or time data from Node-RED, similar to how I/O signals are accessed.
